verdict: Client has pending software updates but no open or upcoming maintenance window allows them to install.
fix: In the console, inspect the target collection's maintenance windows. Confirm at least one window exists with the correct type (`Software Updates` or `All deployments`; `Task Sequences` alone will not permit update installs). Verify the window schedule lines up with the expected install time (time zone / recurrence). If the business deadline is past, updates will eventually install outside the window.
